# Dodge [Action]

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Actions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DodgeAction)*

If you take the Dodge action, you gain the following benefits: until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has [Disadvantage](../../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with [Advantage](../../D20-Tests/Advantage.md).

You lose these benefits if you have the [Incapacitated](../../Conditions/Incapacitated.md) condition or if your [Speed](../../Movement/Speed.md) is 0.
